set.body: Follow-up from the typed-lucidity pass. Event ADT cases currently expose public product constructors that can admit negative sample counts, non-finite summaries, inconsistent intervals, and invalid dispersions. Introduce private constructors plus lucid smart constructors or proven summary types; keep detector call sites readable and return operand-rich CoreError values. Add construction and type-rejection tests.
set.title: Make event summaries coherent by construction
